scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructed from independent exponential racing, inclusion-exclusion, Laplace-difference concordance, and exact scalar differentiation; finite standard-library fraction checks corroborate but do not establish universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Independent proportional-hazard components; exact population rank concordance only. No censored-data or finite-sample inference theorem. Two-rate inverse does not identify labels or absolute hazards. Exponential-time subset sum can be numerically ill-conditioned in floating point; historical equivalence remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact extreme-order Kendall concordance for heterogeneous proportional hazards
